name: Application.evtx
purpose: Records application-generated events including crashes, installer errors, and some AV/EDR product logging.
normal_baseline: Occasional application crash/error entries consistent with normal software instability.
anomalies: Crash entries for a security product coinciding with an incident timeframe
anti_forensic_notes: Lower signal-to-noise than Security/System logs for security investigations; useful mainly to corroborate AV/EDR crash-based defense evasion.
